attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"He touched the letter she had clutched until her final breath—the one from Ada.","severity":"minor","reason":"briefing says she received the letter on day 744, not that she held it when she died; added detail about the past"},{"span":"He would pack the remaining supplies","severity":"minor","reason":"implies surviving supplies, though the caravan was lost; the briefing does not support this"},{"span":"the blizzard still howling like a ghost","severity":"minor","reason":"the blizzard was the cause of death on day 790; Constance died day 803, so a blizzard still howling is a questionable present-moment claim"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The scene is clear and ends on a fitting resolve to go to Ada, but it leans on stock melodrama (marble skin, howling ghost, stray tear). It also adds unsupported details, namely the letter clutched at death and supplies left after the caravan was lost, and it places the death scene in the passes although Constance died 13 days after the caravan was lost."}
